Arjun: @here lunchtime toss-up: "Lunar Laps" (3x quick circuit around the creek path) vs Bodyweight AMRAP (15-min push-ups/pistols/plank rounds). Loser buys cold brew. :coffee:
Mei: AMRAP for me. need a core reset.
Carla: Laps. trying to keep sub-9 per lap. :runner:
Devon: Either. heads-up: path has a slick patch by the north bench if it rained. wear grippy shoes.
Zoe: AMRAP. Also can we add a "no-drop" rule for push-ups? :eyes:
Arjun: Signup format: `@name - pick - meetup - notes`
Carla: `@Carla - lunar laps - creek path - shooting for sub-9`
Mei: `@Mei - amrap - lobby mat - bringing mini band + timer`
Devon: `@Devon - either - lobby - on-call window 12:45-12:55`
Zoe: `@Zoe - amrap - lobby mat - will time rounds`
Arjun: Current split: 2 AMRAP / 1 laps / 1 flexible. Facilities okayed mats and path access. Ill ping security about the slick patch.
Carla: Tiny stakes twist: AMRAP gets double points for a clean pistol. Loser does one victory lap wearing a silly hat.
Mei: :thumbsup: I will wear the silly hat if I lose.
FitBot: Reminder set - "Lunar Laps vs Bodyweight AMRAP" tomorrow 12:20. React with :bell: to confirm.
Devon: :bell:
Zoe: :bell: whoever times AMRAP picks the cold brew flavor.
Arjun: Deal. See you 12:30. Bring shoes, mats, and bravado.
